installCommand: git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git && flutter/bin/flutter config --enable-web && flutter/bin/flutter doctor
buildCommand: echo "SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL" > .env && echo "SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY" >> .env && flutter/bin/flutter build web --release && cp .env build/web/.env
